aiStatement: In Enhanced Fleet Data Segment (Response) (Data Segment No. 146), field 1 (Segment Type) is required and must be present.

facts: Segment 146 response field 1 / Element 85 is required and has fixed value 146.
sourceConclusion.caveat: This fixed value applies to the Segment 146 container, not any Segment Type field in the broader transaction payload.

aiCaseAssessment.assessment: A catalog listing is not proof of a Segment 146 wire value. The three Element 85 observations require container binding; one unresolved physical candidate is 100. Four cases have no exact Segment 146 observation; TC-013007 is among them and does not list Segment Type in its expected-response catalog, while two approved payload copies are missing.

requiredEvidenceForAdjudication: Bind Element 85 to the response Segment 146 container in all relevant cases and inspect the exact value.
Resolve the producer response-field catalog versus physical-payload differences, especially TC-013007's missing approved copies.
Confirm response applicability and full Segment 146 length/framing with an authorized Test owner.
Obtain independent structural validation and execution evidence before any coverage decision.
